system.name: SWING
system.one_liner: Space Walks for Implicit Network Graphs: random-feature graph computations on implicit graphs by walking in the continuous embedding space with Gumbel-softmax sampling.

content.variant_note: the same nodes redrawn as points, graph and walked graph above a red line, then the SWING step as a pictorial formula and a continuous-space walk below
content.argues: SWING replaces walks on a built graph by walks in the nodes' continuous space, each step a Gumbel-softmax convex sum of vectors to the nodes.
content.subject: A bunny point cloud turned into a graph and walked, versus a Gumbel-softmax step and a walk in continuous space.

lessons.what_to_learn: Use one concrete instance (a point cloud) through the whole figure: zoom into it, show the baseline as chevron-linked snapshots above a red line, then give the new mechanism below as a pictorial formula with colour-ramped bars that shares its colour code with the geometric picture it equals.
lessons.suits: Mechanism figures for sampling, graph or kernel methods where a formula and a geometric step must be read together on a concrete example.

evidence: SWING bypasses this step by conducting those random walks in the continuous d-dimensional space
Each transition in such a walk (see: orange arrow) is obtained as a convex sum of the vectors
That turns out to provide differentiable relaxation of the discrete random walk.

summary: SWING (Space Walks for Implicit Network Graphs) computes Graph Random Features on implicit graphs, whose edge weights are functions of node feature vectors, without building the graph: random walks happen in the continuous space where the nodes are embedded, each step being a Gumbel-softmax convex combination of vectors to the nodes. Figure 1 uses a bunny point cloud as the example. Above a red line, regular GRF: a red circle zooms into the points, grey chevrons lead to an explicit graph and then to blue random-walk arrows on it. Below, SWING: a pictorial formula (coefficients c1-c9 equal norm(exp) of colour-ramped log-weight bars plus grey Gumbel bars) equals a star of nine coloured neighbours, giving an orange step that starts a blue walk among unconnected green points.
summary_zh: SWING 不构造图，直接在节点嵌入的连续空间中随机游走，每步为 Gumbel-softmax 凸组合。图 1 以兔子点云为例：红线上方是常规做法（放大点云、建显式图、游走），下方用柱状公式、九邻居星形图和橙色步长展示 SWING。
notes: Prior labels kept (worked-walkthrough, concept-schematic) and side-by-side-contrast added for the regular-GRF-versus-SWING split at the red line. The supplied text does not define tau; it is read as the label of the Gumbel column. The hexes of c7 and c9 are not in the digest and are left out of the palette. There are no panel letters; the two tiers are described in arrangement_note.
